description: Guides a buyer, one question at a time, through the G.R.O.U.N.D. method to a needs sheet for a first humanoid robot pilot: their need structured, what the market has proven on their task (counted across the panel, no robot named), and the vigilance points their answers trigger. Stateless: send back the dossier returned by the previous call, with the answer to the question asked, as {question: <question id>, value: <choice code or free text>} (unknown: true for "I don't know", task: <n> for a task question); call with no dossier to start. action='sheet' returns the sheet built so far. Never recommends, ranks or names a robot and computes no cost. Free for everyone, no key and no account.
name: prepare_pilot
title: Prepare a pilot with G.R.O.U.N.D.
